sections.heading: What is MER?: Marketing Efficiency Ratio
paragraphs: Marketing Efficiency Ratio (MER), also known as Blended ROAS or Ecosystem ROAS, measures how many dollars in revenue your business generates for every $1 spent on marketing , regardless of which platform or channel drove the conversion.
Unlike channel-specific ROAS, MER gives you a holistic, big-picture view of your entire marketing performance across all channels combined.

sections.heading: MER vs ROAS: What's the Difference?

bullets.label: ROAS
bullets.text: is channel-specific and attribution-dependent (e.g., Facebook ROAS, Google ROAS)

bullets.label: MER
bullets.text: includes ALL revenue regardless of attribution and ALL marketing costs
MER accounts for the full marketing ecosystem including team salaries, software, agencies, and creative costs

sections.heading: How to Calculate MER: The Formula
paragraphs: For example, if your business generated $100 in revenue and spent $100 on all marketing efforts, your MER is $100 / $100 = 3.0x (or 300%)
This means you generate $3 in revenue for every $1 spent on marketing .
sections.formula: MER = Total Revenue / Total Marketing Spend

sections.heading: What is a Good MER?
paragraphs: A "good" MER varies by industry, but as a rule of thumb:
Industry benchmarks (2025): Apparel 2.8x, Health & Wellness 2.0x, Food & Beverage 2.1x, Electronics 2.4x, Pets 1.9x

bullets.label: Below 2x
bullets.text: Difficult to be profitable (spending 50%+ of revenue)
